options.text: An identification pattern drawn to recognise the star group, not real solid lines in the sky.
Real glowing threads stretched between stars in space.
Only the stars on the pencil lines belong to the constellation; nearby unmarked stars in the same sky region do not.
The lines are real if drawn solid and imaginary only if drawn dotted.

stem:
Pihu sketches a curved star pattern she saw from her terrace. She joins several bright stars with pencil lines so her classmates can recognise the shape.

What do those pencil lines represent?

teacher.key_rationale: Constellation drawings use imaginary identification lines. They are not real sky threads, do not limit membership to the drawn figure alone, and stroke style does not change that.
